QuestInfo.name: The Name Larelle
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2430002##k proved to be kind and helpful, if a little judgmental, so Alpha and Beta decided to ask her about the Goddess Teardrop.
QuestInfo.1: But just when things were looking up, #p2430002# seemed to get cold feet! She definitely knew something, but insisted the duo talk to the town's elder, #bChief Stan#k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2430001# appreciated the help with Maya, but he refused to talk about the Goddess Teardrop. It seemed as though all of #m323000000# had been scarred by some event. Was the teardrop causing all of this mess? And why does this #p2420000# keep coming up in conversation?

0.0: Larelle's been a little boy since I've known him. At first I thought it was a glandular disorder, but now I'm not so sure. I kinda feel sorry for him, but maybe I shouldn't...
0.1: I-I've already said too much. Chief Stan didn't want anyone to talk about Larelle. Maybe it'd be best if you just went to #bChief Stan#k directly.
